summary.honesty: A path equals its weakest link: 1/1 paths carry EVERY link verified; the rest are INFERRED and name their weak links. No link is ever marked verified without an evidence reference traceable to a verified finding, a raw journal entry, or a scan artifact. Chained paths additionally require every hop evidenced; an inferred bridge (e.g. script execution not demonstrated) makes the whole chain INFERRED.
